newsitem.title: UK: B.A.T lifted by strong Imperial debut.
newsitem.headline: B.A.T lifted by strong Imperial debut.

text.p: Shares in B.A.T Industries Plc gained on Tuesday on the back of a strong early performance by Imperial Tobacco Plc, which began trading after its demerger from conglomerate Hanson Plc.
B.A.T was up 9p at 434-1/2 by 0750 GMT, after closing yesterday near its low for the year of 422p set on August 22.
Imperial was quoted at 390-1/2, after earlier reaching a high of 395p, compared with expectations it would start at between 370p and 380p.
"Imperial has had such a strong opening and that's what's boosted B.A.T," said one market-maker.
He said B.A.T shares had lagged in recent sessions on expectations that some fund managers would pare their holdings of B.A.T to make way for Imperial.
B.A.T was also hit last week as Kleinwort Benson cut its rating on the stock to "underweight" from "hold".
